reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthActionCategories selection and parses tags with the shared extractTagsFromText instead of a new regex.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is written once, in getFixedGroupIds plus one filter clause; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The exclusion sits in the shared month-wide selection in budget/actions.ts, where the hidden and template exclusions already live.

scope.why: Only the selection helper, its comment/return type and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Small, documented change to the single definition every month-wide action uses.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setLastMonthSpending, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) go through getMonthActionCategories.

one_place.where: getMonthActionCategories in budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action.
